conflicts_in.fact: Lesson 1 derives h = b sin C from a right-angled triangle with the right angle at B, hypotenuse AC = b, and then claims the formula works for any triangle; the diagram setup is internally inconsistent (a right angle at B makes h = AB, so sin C = h/b is fine, but the lesson then drops the right angle for a general triangle).
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 1 labels b = AC as the hypotenuse of a right triangle at B, then removes the right angle and keeps b as AC.

conflicts_in.fact: Whether the pentagon is part of the courtyard: the phenomenon lists pentagon among courtyard formulas, and Lesson 7's family tree and Lesson 6 model-building treat it variously; Lesson 6 says it is a standalone tray context, but Lesson 6's Explained says the contractor can find the area of a pentagon tile.
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 6 overview: standalone njugu tray separate from the courtyard, yet its Explained says the contractor finds the area of a regular pentagon tile; Lesson 8 says pentagon is not part of the courtyard layout.
